name: layer:p1-goal-plan
description: CLAUDE.md §1 — Goal & plan structure (what the work is and how it will be verified).

name: layer:p2-precode
description: CLAUDE.md §2 — Pre-code reasoning (fact vs. speculation, assumptions, ambiguity).

name: layer:p3-harness
description: CLAUDE.md §3 — Delivery harness (issues, CI, hooks, deps, PR loop).

name: layer:p4-artifact
description: CLAUDE.md §4 — Artifact code (simplicity bounded by safety).

name: layer:meta
description: Repo infrastructure (labels, rulesets, workflows) for the meta-document. NOT a CLAUDE.md principle.

name: type:feat
description: New behaviour or rule added to the meta-document or repo.

name: type:fix
description: Defect: contradiction, broken workflow, wrong doc.

name: type:docs
description: Operator runbooks / README (not the meta-document itself).

name: state:rfc
description: Open but unactioned per §2; agent must not pre-empt.

name: state:parked
description: Explicitly deferred; requires evidence to revive.

name: severity:security
description: Security-sensitive; overrides agent routing toward investigate.

name: severity:non-ascii-content
description: Non-ASCII in title/body/comment; advisory for trusted authors, blocks external contributors.
